Live Canvas Agent Protocol
|-- [M] Bound tool gateway: AgentDiagrammingSessionService
|   |-- Public entry points: callBound, call, submitDirect
|   |   |-- Contracts define tool schemas and canvas/nodes/edges methods
|   |   `-- Private machinery owns attachment, dispatch, snapshots and retry execution
|   |-- [C] callBound(token, tool, arguments)
|   |   |-- Capture chat target and read-only access
|   |   |-- Lazily attach targeted calls to captured canvas + document
|   |   |   |-- Verify document appears in the canvas descriptor
|   |   |   |-- Read identity; retain sessionId -> canvasId + documentId + optional changeSessionId
|   |   |   `-- Conflicting caller attachment -> CHAT_BINDING_MISMATCH
|   |   `-- Validate arguments -> enforce tool/method permissions -> resolve references -> execute
|   |-- [O] Request history belongs to the service
|   |   |-- Key includes access mode, change session, tool, session and requestId
|   |   |-- Same key + same arguments -> reuse promise
|   |   |-- Same key + changed arguments -> REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT
|   |   |-- Ambiguous transport failure -> remove request promise so identical retry can proceed
|   |   `-- Successful versioned pure exec reads release cached payloads
|   `-- [C] Route according to attachment
|       |-- Live document -> CanvasSessionPort dispatches to owning browser
|       |-- Proposal document -> ChangeSessionService supplies snapshots and applies operations
|       |   `-- Attachment must match changeSessionId; proposal save cannot publish catalog revisions
|       `-- Generated edits/batches -> edit services -> bound browser revision/create/batch commands
|
|-- [M] Script execution boundary: AgentExecRuntime -> QuickJsAgentRuntime
|   |-- Exposes frozen canvas, nodes and edges API groups through an invoke callback
|   |   `-- Session service validates each method and converts mutations to DiagramOperations
|   |-- [C] exec(code, sessionId, requestId, expectedVersion)
|   |   |-- Capture initial document version
|   |   |-- Mutation requires expectedVersion == initial version
|   |   |-- Batched mode: queue consecutive mutations and return provisional IDs
|   |   |   |-- Reads and other barriers flush pending operations
|   |   |   `-- Successful script end flushes remaining operations -> compact mutation receipts
|   |   `-- Immediate mode: apply each mutation -> advance version -> return projected node/edge
|   |-- [O] ExecRun retains ordered steps and batches while an outcome is uncertain
|   |   |-- Each step freezes arguments, generated IDs and execution closure
|   |   |-- Each batch retains operation indices, expectedVersion and result/error
|   |   |-- Retry replays completed API outcomes; resends only unacknowledged work
|   |   |   `-- Stable request IDs and versions survive the retry; changed call sequence is rejected
|   |   `-- Success or non-transport failure removes the run; ambiguity keeps it retryable
|   `-- [O] One QuickJS context per run
|       |-- Limits: 32 MiB memory, 512 KiB stack, 30-second deadline, 100 API calls
|       |-- API and final result JSON each limited to 4 MiB
|       `-- finally -> dispose context, including on failure
|
|-- [M] Browser command transport: CanvasSessionPort -> CanvasSessionBridge
|   |-- Contract: register/list, dispatch/poll/reply, unregister/dispose
|   |-- [C] dispatch(canvasId, command)
|   |   `-- Allocate commandId + pending promise -> enqueue -> wake browser poll
|   |       `-- useAgentCanvasBridge receives commands through HTTP polling
|   |           |-- Invoke supplied browser handle(command) sequentially
|   |           |-- Encode value/error with canvasReply -> POST reply
|   |           |   `-- Rejected reply body -> send compact CANVAS_REPLY_REJECTED error
|   |           `-- Bridge matches canvasId + commandId -> resolve/reject caller
|   |-- [O] Bridge owns descriptors, queues, wake callbacks and pending timers
|   |   |-- Empty poll waits up to 15 seconds; dispatch permits at most 100 pending commands
|   |   |-- No reply after 25 seconds -> remove pending command and report uncertain outcome
|   |   |-- list() retires registrations untouched for more than 35 seconds
|   |   `-- Unregister/dispose -> wake pollers, clear timers, reject pending commands
|   `-- [O] Browser hook owns an ephemeral canvasId, polling loop and reply cache
|       |-- Registers descriptor with stable workspace identity; refreshes registration after polls
|       |-- Caches mutation results by commandId, retaining at most 200
|       |-- Polling failure -> retry loop after 1 second
|       `-- Cleanup -> abort requests, clear retry timer and unregister
|           `-- pagehide also unregisters the ephemeral instance
|
|-- [M] Live selection/context boundary: LiveCanvasService + browser publisher
|   |-- Public protocol v2: publish, attach, selection updates, context, copy/paste, context upload
|   |-- [O] One publisher per workspace instance; owner identity guards updates and replies
|   |   |-- Publisher retains per-document selection snapshots
|   |   `-- Each agent binding pins workspaceInstanceId + documentId + canvasEpoch
|   |-- [C] Browser publishes visible draft sessions
|   |   |-- observeCanvasSelection subscribes to each document controller
|   |   |   `-- Coalesce changes -> sample completed regions and whole-diagram selections
|   |   |-- Publisher ready/reconnected -> send current full snapshots
|   |   |-- Later changes -> send selection.delta against last transmitted snapshot
|   |   |   `-- Backpressure above 64 KiB -> defer drain; pending state coalesces per document
|   |   `-- LiveCanvasService.update -> validate -> store mirror -> notify matching agent bindings
|   |       |-- Old sequence in same epoch -> ignore
|   |       |-- Delta needs matching epoch and baseSequence -> otherwise SELECTION_OUT_OF_SYNC
|   |       `-- Enforce unique/bounded regions and diagram IDs; whole diagrams exclude their regions
|   |-- [D] Selection delta
|   |   |-- Last transmitted regions + next regions -> changed/upserted and removed region IDs
|   |   |-- Previous sequence -> baseSequence
|   |   `-- Changed whole-diagram set -> replacement diagramIds
|   |-- [D] Region text and stale flag
|   |   |-- Selection rectangle + selected IDs + current diagram -> clipboard text
|   |   `-- Captured ASCII or box/content binding differs -> stale region preserving captured text
|   |-- [C] Agent attach -> initial bound selection; context request -> loadContext callback
|   |   |-- Context uses compact projection shared with tool reads
|   |   `-- Recheck publisher/epoch and binding after await -> reject replaced or closed canvas
|   |-- [C] Socket copy/paste commands execute in the owning browser
|   |   |-- Normalize supplied text -> retain command -> publisher forwards to browser receiver
|   |   |-- Copy requires diagram.copy capability; stages ephemeral text for user placement
|   |   |-- Paste carries expectedVersion, position and a fixed generated nodeId
|   |   |   `-- Successful reply must match nodeId and expectedVersion + 1
|   |   `-- [O] Receipts keyed by workspace + document + epoch + requestId
|   |       |-- Changed arguments -> REQUEST_ID_REUSED; completed result -> reuse
|   |       |-- Timeout -> retain command for identical retry
|   |       `-- Never evict receipts; reject new work when history capacity is reached
|   `-- [O] Identity and connection lifecycle
|       |-- Hidden/removed/replaced browser draft -> dispose observer and publish removal
|       |-- Document removal/new epoch/publisher disconnect -> invalidate affected bindings
|       |   `-- Reject pending copy/paste waits and notify agents of closed/replaced/disconnected state
|       |-- Agent attach/detach/invalidation -> publish current connected-agent count
|       `-- Browser publisher cleanup -> unsubscribe, dispose observers, clear timers/maps, close socket
|
|-- [M] Read and reference boundary: compact output, full IDs inside domain state
|   |-- [D] currentCanvasRead(state, level, nodeIds)
|   |   |-- Scene + diagram revisions + presentation state -> diagram text and anchors
|   |   |-- Source mappings + evidence + anchor spans -> source ranges for each content node
|   |   |-- Revision relationships -> active/stale highlights and jumps
|   |   |-- Small: selected diagrams with complete source evidence, without constructing geometry/history
|   |   `-- Full: add geometry, edges and canvas view
|   |-- [O] CanvasReadAliases: immutable tables for canvas.read results
|   |   |-- Each read binds aliases to canvas + document + optional change session
|   |   |-- Arguments resolve only against the same binding
|   |   |-- Expired/missing table -> STALE_READ; wrong binding -> READ_BINDING_MISMATCH
|   |   `-- Retain at most 128 reads, 30-minute TTL; never reassign an alias
|   `-- [O] CanvasApiProjection: revision-scoped content-anchor handles
|       |-- Projects nodes, edges, highlights, jumps and migrations; strips duplicate/internal fields
|       |-- Full revision/hash identity -> opaque handle; reverse table decodes mutation inputs
|       |-- Handles are shared across tool/live reads through the projection instance
|       `-- Never evict/reassign handles; unknown handle -> STALE_CONTENT_NODE and reread
|
`-- [M] Collaborating services beyond the live protocol
    |-- [C] Agent context
    |   |-- Live upload -> AgentContextService.upload with bound canvas/document scope
    |   |-- Edit generation resolves agentContextId within that same scope
    |   `-- Diagram context prepare/delete requires expected document version + diagram revision
    |       `-- Retain prepared mutation payload so retry dispatches the same context
    |-- [C] Search
    |   `-- Bound live snapshot / pinned proposal state / saved catalog revision -> projected results
    `-- [C] Save -> MappingDiagramService
        |-- Serialize saves per live canvas/document
        |-- Whole document: browser checkpoint -> publishCheckpoint -> notify browser saved
        |-- One diagram: version-checked snapshot -> isolate diagram/history -> save
        `-- Publication can succeed even if browser notification fails: displayUpdated = false
